source_name: ČNB ARAD – systém časových řad (ARAD time series system)
why_relevant: ARAD is the CNB's public aggregated time-series database and the canonical delivery vehicle for payment statistics, card/ATM/POS counts, monetary and banking statistics. Every CZ payment number quoted downstream ultimately resolves to an ARAD series.

source_name: ARAD-REST-API documentation (ČNB)
why_relevant: Technical contract for machine access to ARAD: the REST service exposes the same indicator set and values as the ARAD web application, making automated long-term collection of CZ payment/card/cash series feasible without scraping.

source_name: Komentář ke statistice platebního styku (Commentary on payment statistics) – ČNB
why_relevant: Semi-annual narrative release accompanying the payment statistics: number of client accounts, payment cards by type, card-acceptance devices (ATMs and POS terminals) by type and geography, and transaction counts by payment service. This is the headline release that press and vendors quote.

source_name: ČNB – Harmonizovaná měnová statistika (harmonised monetary statistics data)
why_relevant: Hub page for ECB-harmonised statistical outputs including the payment statistics data section; the natural crawl entry point that links to the underlying data tables and their English mirrors.

source_name: ČNB – Bankovní statistika (banking statistics)
why_relevant: Aggregate banking-sector balance sheet, deposits/loans and institution counts — the denominator context for payment and card penetration metrics and for sizing the addressable CZ bank market.

source_name: CERTIS – statistické údaje (interbank payment system statistics)
why_relevant: CERTIS is the sole CZK interbank payment system, operated by ČNB. Monthly and annual transaction counts/values (and the instant-payment share) are the highest-frequency hard indicator of CZ payment volumes.

source_name: ČNB – CERTIS: popis systému (system description) and Payments section
why_relevant: Structural/methodological description of CERTIS: participant model, settlement mechanics, clearing rules. Needed to interpret the statistics correctly and to map which institutions actually clear CZK.

source_name: ČNB – Okamžité platby (instant payments) incl. participant list
why_relevant: Instant payments are the fastest-moving CZ payment segment and the main structural competitor to card and cash transactions. ČNB publishes both the volumes and a versioned PDF list of participating institutions — a ready-made actor map with adoption dates.

source_name: ČNB – Peněžní oběh (currency circulation / cash statistics)
why_relevant: ČNB is the sole issuer of CZK banknotes and coins and publishes the value/volume of currency in circulation, denomination structure and counterfeit statistics — the core evidence base for cash-usage trend analysis against card/instant substitution.

source_name: ČNB – Vykazování statistiky platebního styku (payment statistics reporting rules)
why_relevant: Defines exactly what banks must report and how: reports PSSIVYC22 (quarterly) and PSSIVYP22 (semi-annual, incl. fraud), under ECB Reg. (EU) 2020/2011 amending 1409/2013 and CZ Decree 401/2021 Sb. Essential for series comparability and for knowing which micro-fields exist even when only aggregates are published.

source_name: ČNB SDAT – sběr dat ČNB (supervisory/statistical data collection system)
why_relevant: SDAT is the collection platform behind all CZ bank reporting (incl. PSD2/EBA_PAY taxonomies). Its published methodology catalogue reveals the full field inventory of payment, fraud, card and terminal reporting — a map of what data exists even where only aggregates surface publicly.

source_name: ČNB – Výroční zpráva (Annual Report)
why_relevant: Annual consolidated narrative on currency issuance, payment system operation (CERTIS, instant payments), supervision and financial-market structure. Useful for year-over-year framing and for catching numbers not exposed as ARAD series.

source_name: ČNB – Zpráva o finanční stabilitě (Financial Stability Report)
why_relevant: Semi-annual analytical report on the CZ banking sector's health, profitability and structure — context for bank IT/infrastructure spending capacity and for sector consolidation signals relevant to payments vendors.

source_name: ČNB – Zprávy o výkonu dohledu nad finančním trhem (Financial Market Supervision Reports)
source_subtype: supervisory annual report series (index page + PDFs)
why_relevant: Annual supervision report with licensing activity, sector-by-sector analyses and counts of regulated entities including payment institutions and e-money institutions — a structured view of CZ payment-market entry and exit.

source_name: ČNB JERRS – Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů
why_relevant: Statutory register of every licensed/registered CZ financial-market entity: banks, foreign bank branches, payment institutions, e-money institutions, small-scale payment service providers. The definitive actor map for the CZ payments market.

source_name: ČNB – Otevřená data (open data)
why_relevant: Lists the datasets ČNB publishes as open data under Government Regulation 425/2016 Sb. (e.g. current list of banks and foreign bank branches, bureaux de change, credit intermediaries) and links them into the national catalogue — the cleanest legally-sanctioned machine-readable feed from ČNB.

source_name: ČNB – Seznamy institucí pro potřeby měnové a finanční statistiky
why_relevant: Defines the statistical reporting population (MFIs and other institution lists) used to compile the monetary and payment statistics. Needed to know exactly which institutions are inside each aggregate — a common source of misinterpretation downstream.

source_name: ČNB – Statistika (statistics portal root)
why_relevant: Top-level index of every statistical domain ČNB compiles (monetary and financial, balance of payments, supervisory, financial accounts, general economic, government finance). The master pointer for discovering series that fall outside the payments pages but still carry payment-relevant detail.

source_name: ČNB – Kalendář: Payment statistics (release calendar entry)
why_relevant: Publication calendar for the payment statistics release — lets collection be scheduled to the actual release date instead of blind polling, and flags schedule changes.

source_name: ČNB – Tiskové zprávy (press releases)
why_relevant: First public surfacing of headline payment/cash numbers (e.g. instant-payment volume milestones, currency-in-circulation updates) and of methodology or system changes, often ahead of the ARAD series refresh.

source_name: ČNB blog (cnBlog) – analytical posts on cash and payments
why_relevant: Staff-authored analytical commentary that interprets the cash and payment statistics (why banknotes remain popular, cash vs. card substitution). Useful for methodology insight and for the central bank's own read of the trend, though it is commentary rather than a data series.

source_name: cnbprovsechny.cnb.cz – ČNB plain-language mirror
why_relevant: A parallel ČNB domain ('ČNB pro všechny' – accessible/plain-language version) that mirrors many statistics and payment pages. Valuable as a fallback fetch target when the main site's page is unreachable or restructured, and as a cross-check on content changes.

source_name: ECB Data Portal — Payments statistics (PAY dataset, key indicators)
why_relevant: Current harmonised ECB payments-statistics dataset (post-Regulation (EU) 2020/2011) covering all EU/EEA reporting countries including Czechia: card payments, credit transfers, direct debits, e-money, POS terminals, ATMs, semi-annual and quarterly. Machine-readable, English metadata, cross-country comparable — the backbone series for CZ card/POS/ATM benchmarking.

source_name: ECB Data Portal — Payments and Settlement Systems Statistics (PSS, discontinued legacy series)
why_relevant: Legacy harmonised series (annual, from 2000) on access/usage of payment services, payment terminals and national retail/large-value systems; search result indicated ~3,401 Czech Republic series. Essential for LONG time series before the 2022 methodology change and for identifying the definitional break between PSS and PAY.

source_name: ECB Data Portal — Payment card accepting devices (data category)
why_relevant: Category landing page enumerating the exact terminal/POS/ATM series keys (terminals provided by resident PSPs, e-funds transfer POS, ATMs) — the fastest route to the correct series identifiers for CZ terminal-estate tracking, which is the core Printec-relevant indicator family.

source_name: ECB Payments statistics press releases (semi-annual, e.g. first half of 2025)
why_relevant: Release-calendar anchor and narrative interpretation of each new payments-statistics vintage; flags revisions, breaks and country-level outliers. Gives the exact publication timing to schedule CZ data pulls and provides EU-wide context for CZ card/terminal trends.

source_name: ECB Statistics portal — Czech-language landing page (Statistiky)
why_relevant: Confirms ECB publishes statistical navigation in Czech; useful as a local-language entry point and for the official Czech terminology ECB itself uses (statistika platebního styku), which improves cs-language search recall for supranational material.

source_name: EBA/ECB Joint Report on Payment Fraud (annual, PSD2 Art. 96(6) data)
why_relevant: Only harmonised EU-wide, country-broken-down source on payment fraud by instrument (cards, credit transfers, direct debits, cash withdrawals, e-money), semi-annual, incl. Czechia. Search results indicate CZ appears with above-average per-capita card and credit-transfer fraud losses — high strategic value for security/terminal positioning.
